name: import-leads
description: Takes a lead list from wherever it lives and lands it in HubSpot correctly: mapped, deduped, matched to companies, on the status lists the org's grid names, verified by reading every write back, and written back to a Notion source. Every write sits behind one confirmation, nothing is invented to complete a row, and nobody is guessed. The first job plugin: it owns no database, reads no foundation config, and keeps a private config of its own that nothing else reads or writes.
